task.merge.title: Merge the pull request
task.merge.description: Saka merges the pull request on the code host, then checks the merge commit on the base branch before the task is done.
task.update_branch.title: Update the pull request branch
task.update_branch.description: Saka asks the code host to merge the base into the pull request branch. The change is reviewed again at the new head and merges on its own once it is approved and the checks pass. The branch is never rebased or force-pushed.
task.retry.title: Retry the blocked stage
task.retry.description: The blocker is closed and the stage runs again. Each stage has a limit on manual retries.
external.heading: Changes from outside
external.author: Author
task.start.title: Start this step
task.start.description: This repo asks you before each step. Saka prepares the environment and the agent starts as soon as a slot is free.
task.awaitingStart: Waiting for you to start this step.
task.mergesAuto: Saka merges this by itself once the review approves and the checks pass.
task.review.title: Review
task.review.description: Saka queues a review of the pull request at its current head. The reviewer picks it up when it is ready.
task.fixAction.title: Fix the pull request
task.fixAction.description: Saka checks out the branch of the pull request, lets an agent answer the findings of the review, and pushes the result to that branch. The new head is reviewed again.
task.takeover.title: Take the task over
task.takeover.description: The agent session stops and nothing runs for this task until you hand it back. The pull request, the branch, and the environment stay as they are.
task.return.title: Return the task to the loop
task.return.description: Saka reads the pull request again, takes its latest head, and starts the stage you choose from there. Checks run again on that head.
task.takenOver.title: Taken over
task.takenOver.body: The loop is paused for this task. Push your work to the branch, then return the task to the loop:
task.cancel.title: Cancel the task
task.cancel.description: The agent session stops and the task environment is removed. The pull request stays open, and the steps after this one are not started.

lint.not_a_spec: This file is not a Saka spec: its frontmatter needs saka: spec.
lint.file_too_large: The spec is {bytes} bytes; the limit is {max_bytes} bytes.
lint.invalid_utf8: The spec is not valid UTF-8 text.
lint.slug_invalid: The file name gives the slug "{slug}", which is not valid: use lowercase letters, digits, and dashes.
lint.title_missing: The spec needs a title: a level-1 heading (# Title).
lint.ac_section_missing: The spec needs an "Acceptance criteria" section.
lint.ac_id_invalid: "{id}" is not a valid acceptance criterion ID; use AC-01, AC-02, and so on.
lint.ac_id_duplicate: {id} is used for more than one acceptance criterion.
lint.steps_missing: The spec needs a Steps table or a "Done when" section.
lint.steps_column_missing: The Steps table needs a "{column}" column.
lint.step_limit_exceeded: A spec can have at most {max_steps} steps.
lint.step_ac_empty: Step {step} does not name any acceptance criterion.
lint.step_ac_unknown: Step {step} names {ac}, which is not in the acceptance criteria.
lint.step_command_missing: Step {step} needs at least one command in "Done when".
lint.step_repo_invalid: Step {step} has "{repo}" in the Repo column, which is not a valid repository name.
lint.frontmatter_invalid: {reason, select, duplicate_key {The frontmatter key "{key}" appears more than once.} other {The frontmatter line "{key}" is not in the form key: value.}}
lint.priority_invalid: Priority "{value}" is not a whole number from -1000 to 1000.
lint.depends_on_invalid: depends_on "{value}" must be a list of spec slugs.
lint.depends_on_self: The spec cannot depend on itself ({slug}).
lint.step_after_unknown: Step {step} waits for {after}, which is not a step in this spec.
lint.step_after_cycle: These steps wait for each other in a loop: {steps}.
lint.done_when_with_steps: Use either a Steps table or a "Done when" section, not both.
lint.done_when_item_invalid: "Done when" item {item} needs exactly one command in backticks.
lint.ac_uncovered: {ac} is not covered by any step.
lint.step_parallel_start: Step {step} does not wait for any other step, so it starts at the same time as S1.
lint.depends_on_unknown: The spec depends on {slug}, which is not a spec in this project.
lint.depends_on_withdrawn: The spec depends on {slug}, which was withdrawn.
lint.depends_on_cycle: The specs depend on each other in a loop: {cycle}.
lint.step_repo_unknown: Step {step} runs in repository "{repo}", which this project does not bind.
lint.links_limit_exceeded: The spec has more links than the {limit} that are followed.
lint.reference_outside_workspace: The link {target} points outside the workspace.
lint.reference_not_doc: The link to {path} is not a markdown document, so it is not added as context.
lint.reference_missing: The linked document {path} does not exist on the base branch.
lint.reference_not_text: The {origin, select, always {always-included} other {linked}} document {path} is not valid UTF-8 text.
lint.reference_too_large: The {origin, select, always {always-included} other {linked}} document {path} is {bytes} bytes; the limit is {limit} bytes.
lint.context_too_large: {reason, select, bytes {The context documents add up to {bytes} bytes; the limit is {limit} bytes.} always_candidates {There are {count} always-included documents; the limit is {limit}.} other {The spec has {count} context documents; the limit is {limit}.}}
lint.decision_id_invalid: The heading "{heading}" under Decisions should look like "Q1: question".
lint.decision_id_duplicate: {id} is used for more than one decision.
lint.decision_limit_exceeded: A spec can have at most {max} decisions.
lint.decision_options_invalid: {reason, select, missing {Decision {id} needs a list of two or three options.} count {Decision {id} has {count} options; it needs two or three.} other {Option {option} of decision {id} needs a checkbox: start it with [ ].}}
lint.decision_recommendation_invalid: {reason, select, first_missing {The first option of decision {id} should be the recommended one, marked (recommended).} other {Only the first option of decision {id} can be marked (recommended), but option {option} is too.}}
lint.decision_answer_multiple: Decision {id} has more than one option checked; check exactly one.
lint.decision_unanswered: Decision {id} is not answered yet: check one option.
lint.kind_invalid: The kind "{value}" is not one of feature, bugfix, refactor, chore, or security_patch.
lint.regression_missing: A bugfix needs a Regression section with at least one command.
lint.regression_command_invalid: Regression item {item} needs exactly one command in backticks.
lint.regression_too_many: The Regression section has {found} commands; the limit is {max}.
lint.regression_ignored: Only a bugfix uses the Regression section, so Saka ignores it here.
lint.bugfix_multi_step: A bugfix is one step: the test-first rule covers a single step, and this one has {count} steps. Split it into one spec per bug.

connection.incompatible.unreadable: The server (version {serverVersion}) reports an API version this app cannot read. Update both to matching versions.
connections.title: Servers
connections.intro: Saka connects to one server at a time. Switching restarts the app.
connections.setup.title: Connect to a Saka server
connections.setup.intro: Add a server to start. On the server, create a pairing code in Settings, Devices and sign-in, or run saka auth pair on its host.
connections.reauth.title: Pair again
connections.reauth.intro: This server no longer accepts this app. Create a new pairing code on the server (Settings, Devices and sign-in, or saka auth pair) and enter it here.
connections.saved.title: Saved servers
connections.use.label: Use {name}
connections.remove.label: Remove {name}

connections.add.urlHint: Start with https://. Plain http:// works only for this machine (127.0.0.1 or localhost).
connections.error.invalid_url: That is not a server address. Use the form https://host or https://host:port, with no path.
connections.error.insecure_url: Plain http:// is only accepted for this machine. Use https:// for a remote server.
connections.error.invalid_name: Give the server a name of 1 to 100 characters.
connections.error.pairing_code_invalid: The pairing code is wrong, expired or already used. Create a new one on the server.
connections.error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
connections.error.pairing_unavailable: This server does not use sign-in, so there is nothing to pair with.
